claim_boundary: This single run tests one independently authored observable interpretation of the broad Korean shorthand. It cannot establish a universal definition or make the shorthand a hard exact route.

meta_gates.description: The only principal human subject reads unambiguously as an adult without youthful or school-coded presentation.
The photograph remains non-explicit and scene-led, with face, action, torso or figure, and environmental context readable together rather than a body-fragment crop.
A concrete unfinished action is visibly self-directed rather than a passive display or an inferred hidden-camera event.

Subtle adult visual tension is carried by one legible coverage-and-reveal, occlusion, garment-layer, or material-boundary relation; exposed skin, direct gaze, fitted clothing, or bedroom location alone cannot satisfy it.
Material thickness, overlap, contact shadow, gravity, directional light, or another visible physical cause explains the selected relation.
The intended visual proposition can be described from pixels without seeing the shorthand, prompt, candidate IDs, or metadata.

profile_gate_policy: Every hard gate derived from the independently frozen core and selected post-core profile contract must also pass in the same saved image. Partial or missing evidence is fail.
blocked_render_policy: A blocked or absent render is UNSCORED rather than a quality-zero pixel failure.
